svg.text: De novo, k-mer–based discovery, classification, annotation and visualization of repetitive DNA
Java command-line application · single sequence → whole genome → pan-genome · no reference required
Single FASTA, multi-record FASTA, or a folder
Combined input Large chromosomes (>2 GB) supported via heap (-Xmx).gt;2 GB via 64-bit coordinates (-Xmx).
-lib= / -ref= FASTA of known repeats or genes,
used to annotate clustered repeat families.
FastaReader · IUPAC normalization (U→T, I→C), case / soft-mask aware
low-diversity runs are masked and bridged; blocks ≥ 50 bp form the STR track.
MaskingSequence — count gap-free k-mers on BOTH strands (base-5 codes in an
open-addressing LongCountSet); k-mers seen ≥ 2× are “repeated”. Per-base
coverage is accumulated, then contiguous blocks are merged & length-filtered.
SequencesClustering — each repeat block → 238-slot canonical 4-mer count
vector; cosine in both orientations vs. a chance floor calibrated per run. Linked
blocks become CRP families; unclustered blocks become UCRP. Multithreaded.
→ STR + UCRP + CRP families (forward / reverse strand)
Match family consensus to the library
to genomes → core / accessory / unique, tree.

Genome-scale map of repeat tracks by class
selected at launch by command-line flags
